text:
Sasha (PMM): Quick heads-up — we plan to publish the performance deep-dive + community benchmark next Wed 9am PT. Need final sign-off on the press quote protocol and the CEO soundbite.
Arjun (PR): Thanks — timeline noted. Are we keeping the embargo until publish or short-access for selected press?
Sasha (PMM): Tight embargo until release. A small shortlist will get preview access 24h before for accuracy checks.
Camille (Legal): Ok. Two asks from legal: 1) any comparative claims vs named competitors must have test methodology attached; 2) no unvetted customer names/metrics.
Ibrahim (Eng): Methodology doc draft is here: https://internal.redwood/bench/throughput-v2 — it includes workloads, instance types, quantization settings. Happy to extract a short methods appendix for PR.
Nora (Content): I'll pull a 2-paragraph methods summary and a short methodology appendix link for the post. Will also prepare a one-sentence lay summary for social.
Arjun (PR): For the CEO quote, can Sasha or product confirm approved talking points? We need a final line to use in press emails.
Sasha (PMM): Draft lines: "Our goal is predictable, cost-efficient inference at scale — these results show how runtime + routing optimizations move the needle." Thoughts?
Camille (Legal): Slight tweak: replace "these results show" with "these tests indicate" to soften causal language. Also add an attribution line: "Internal testing; see methodology."
Ibrahim (Eng): Small technical note — please don't include raw token/sec numbers without the hardware and batch context. The benchmark page already shows those details.
Nora (Content): Understood. I'll present numbers as relative improvement percentages and link to the full table in the appendix.
Arjun (PR): Press kit checklist for release day: blog post, benchmark appendix PDF, high-res graphs, CEO quote, short Q&A doc, embargoed press list, and one-pager on customer FAQs. Who owns each?
Sasha (PMM): I'll own the benchmark appendix and the FAQ. Nora owns the blog and social copy. Arjun — you own press outreach. Camille — legal sign-off on all public wording. Ibrahim — final verification of graphs and raw data.
Camille (Legal): I'll aim to finish sign-off by EOD Tuesday. Please route the final assets through me in a single zip.
Arjun (PR): Plan for preview access: send to 6 outlets 24h prior. Draft outreach: short email + one-sheet + select graph. Need to confirm embargo recipients list by Monday.
Sasha (PMM): I'll post the recipient shortlist here once product ops confirms there are no customer conflicts.
Ibrahim (Eng): Quick technical question — are we including A/B routing failure modes in the appendix? Should show degradation curves.
Sasha (PMM): Yes, include graceful fallback numbers. That was a key differentiator we want to highlight.
Nora (Content): Social schedule draft: 3 posts across channels over the first 48h: 9am PT (launch tweet + thread), 1pm PT (graph highlight), 24h follow-up (customer use-case tease). Tweet thread will include 1 short code block for the top-line stat: `~2.4x cost per token reduction (mixed workloads)`. Camille — ok to use that phrasing?
Camille (Legal): Prefer relative language: `~2.4x lower per-token cost in our test configurations`. Also include `Internal testing; see methodology.`
Arjun (PR): Also flag: embargoed outlets must not publish raw CSVs. Add that to the outreach copy.
Sasha (PMM): Good call. Adding a line: "We can provide raw data under NDA for independent verification" for any outlet that requests it.
deploy-bot: Note: scheduled post job created for 2024-11-12T16:00:00Z (pending manual "go").
Arjun (PR): Final ask — who will be on the launch day standby? Need 1 product, 1 eng, 1 PR.
Sasha (PMM): I'll be standby for product, Ibrahim for eng, Arjun for PR.
Nora (Content): I'll push the final social assets before EOD Tuesday and put them in the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/bench-launch.
Camille (Legal): Once assets are in the folder, please @me. I'll do a last pass and mark with :white_check_mark: when done.
Sasha (PMM): Cool — action items: Nora (blog + social copy), Ibrahim (final data verification + graphs), Arjun (press list + outreach), Camille (legal review), me (appendix + FAQs). We reconvene Monday 10am PT if any blockers.
Arjun (PR): Thanks — I'll start drafting the outreach email now and share a thread for approvals. :thumbsup:
Nora (Content): Quick formatting note for the blog: include collapsible code block for the command we used to run the benchmark. Eg: ```bash
python bench.py --workload mixed --runs 5 --quant q4
```
Ibrahim (Eng): That snippet is fine. Also attach the raw run script in the appendix.
Sasha (PMM): Great. If nobody objects, I'll lock in the embargo and outreach plan.
Camille (Legal): No objections from legal. Marking tentative sign-off.
Sasha (PMM): Thanks everyone. Will post the shortlist and final assets links here when ready.
